title: 贝莱德芬克：AI建设延迟令技术普及受限
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think the delays in the build out of AI is all going to make AI the domain of large firms.
segments.zh: 我认为AI建设延迟会让AI成为大公司的专属领域。

segments.en: We have shortages in so many countries of inexpensive energy, and we have shortages of chips and memory, and as these shortages continue, it's a very expensive build out AI.
segments.zh: 许多国家缺乏廉价能源，芯片和内存也短缺，这些短缺持续下去，AI建设成本会非常高。

segments.en: With that expense, it's more of the domain of large companies, and the faster we can build out more capacity than more we can democratize and make it available for everyone.
segments.zh: 成本高企，AI更属于大公司，我们越快扩大产能，就越能民主化，让所有人用上。

segments.en: And I think the dichotomy that we're facing right now, it's the populism that's pretty in the slowdown because we have not articulated and defined what best practices,
segments.zh: 我认为当前面临的分歧是，民粹主义在放缓，因为我们没有阐明和定义最佳实践，

segments.en: and I think that's obviously urgently necessary. But the irony is it actually slows down the democratization of technology. And technology works best when it's dispersed across society.
segments.zh: 这显然急需解决。但讽刺的是，它实际上减缓了技术的民主化。技术分散在社会中时效果最好。

segments.en: And if we are going to see the societal delays whether they're in Europe or let's say New York state, it then creates a longer guide path to make this technology a little more.
segments.zh: 如果我们看到社会层面的延迟，无论是在欧洲还是纽约州，都会拉长路径，让这项技术更……
